items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 6462.84/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-04-23 was Rs 6462.84/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 999.92-10000.0/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +54.7% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 10000.0/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 6462.84/MWh, a +54.7% divergence.

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 139% of daily average
